final: WITH status_rates AS (SELECT s.healtheval, AVG(sc.gbsize / sc.spanmin) AS avg_rate, COUNT(*) AS scan_count FROM scans AS sc JOIN sites AS s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin <> 0 GROUP BY s.healtheval), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS overall_rate FROM status_rates), above AS (SELECT sr.avg_rate, sr.scan_count, o.overall_rate FROM status_rates AS sr CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE o.overall_rate IS NOT NULL AND sr.avg_rate > o.overall_rate) SELECT AVG(avg_rate) AS avg_rate_above_statuses, AVG(scan_count) AS avg_scan_count, AVG(avg_rate - overall_rate) AS avg_excess_rate FROM above
